notes.title: Summer Sale, Linux build & Update 1.0.16 released!
notes.content:
We're glad to say that The Equinox Hunt has a new patch and is ready for Summer Sale!

You can get the game at 50% off!

The patch notes:

 Linux build
 Level design tweaks
 Fixed a secondary objective in the second map
 Added guild emblems throughout the maps

Feel free to join us on our discord server: https://discord.gg/NJWjxwQ

notes.title: Winter Sale & Update 1.0.13 released!
notes.content:
We're glad to say that The Equinox Hunt has a new patch and is ready for winter seasonal sale!

You can get the game at 30%!

The patch notes:

 Multiple improvements to map "Swamp Settlement" 
 Adjusted construction and dismantle time for traps
 A few sound effects have been changed
 Fixed marksmen in map "The Second Crossing"
 Fixed "Hunter alerted" number way too high in some situations
 Added more lore at the end of the game
 Added LMB/RMB to controls list in the settings menu
 Added basic controller support (Keyboard + Mouse emulation)


Feel free to join us on our discord server: https://discord.gg/NJWjxwQ

Happy holidays!

notes.title: Version 1.0.12 released
notes.content:
Hello,

We've just release the 1.0.12 patch containing some much needed features, fixes and quality of life improvements. Here is the list of changes:

 Added SFX to placing and dismantling traps
 Fixed an issue where starting a zone could erase a save file
 Adjusted the position of the "locked door icon" for big doors
 Sometimes the hunters were turning while falling from stunning or death
 Added title descriptions in zones menu
 Added "NEW!" in front of every unread entry in the knowledge panel
 Added the name of the zone in which a paper was found in the knowledge panel
 Added map item for the last zone
 Remade the map item for the second zone to better resemble the actual map
 Added collider to spike trap when it's activated
 Fixed a bug where the settings menu was being displayed on top of the main menu
 Fixed issue where player was not able to place traps in the 9th zone
 Added a text at the beginning of the first zone to introduce the player to the game's universe
 Fixed an issue where the credits were not displayed correctly on displays with aspect ratio other than 16:9
 The hunters get closer to the origin of a sound
 Added settings in the pause menu

notes.title: Version 1.0.11 released
notes.content:
Hello,

We've just release the 1.0.11 patch containing something fixed for some annoying bugs and balancing throughout the game. Here is the list of changes:

 The player will sometimes slide indefinitely when walking into a solid object
 The player can be stuck on an observable (like a book or newspaper) until he restarts the game
 The player can't place traps in some maps
 Prowler balancing
 More backpacks throughout the game and in more accessible places
 Some objects were not positioned correctly in the second map
 Fixed typos in texts 
 Small UI update for objectives
 Small UI update for the ending stats screen
 Made death indicator disappear more easily
 Made dismantling impossible for spike traps that are triggered
 Fixed some lag spikes
 Fixed an error in the map item from "Swamp Settlement"
 Fixed and error where the game ending achievement was not triggered

notes.title: Version 1.0.10 released
notes.content:
Hello,

We've just release a patch containing some much needed fixes for the game. Here is a list of the changes:


 Reduced volume for loading screen ambiance sound
 Reduced volume for forest ambiance sound

 Fixed a bugged hunter in map "The First Trial"
 Fixed patrol hunters that weren't moving in map "The Deadly Clearing"
 Fixed a bug at the ending of the final map
 Reduced the blood from the player when he's injured

notes.title: The Steam Festival Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hello,
The Steam Game Festival is live and we've prepared a big patch for the demo!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36111989/d32f744012668ee02070f53d619f7b4963d7e08f.png
The update includes:

Bugs fixed:

 Continue button worked without any save
 The ability to throw rocks disappeared
 The AI wouldn't return to their initial positions after respawn
 Papers could be read from far range or through the other side of the wall
 Ambiance music couldn't be heard in some parts of the map
 The player was spawned inside shed without the zoom in 
 The roof of North House wouldn't fully disappear when the player was inside
 Continue button didn't work after leaving the game and returning to it(on the same version)
 The player couldn't pick up item piles after dying and respawning
 The player could break the natural healing if he spammed the button for heal right after being hurt
 The objective would be stuck after saving and respawning
 The player couldn't run after saving and respawning
 The hunter wouldn't show an orange outline while investigating a distraction
  Sparkles for the ground texture
 The player could break the item piles after dying and respawning multiple times
 Lag Spikes in some parts of the map
 The player could get stuck after hiding and leaving the bed in the outpost
 Killing a hunter would result in a weird sound bug
 The player could restore his inventory after respawn if he threw a rock
 A few colliders for objected were placed badly
 Secondary wouldn't disappear once it's done


Tweaks/Polish:

 Player can close the wheel with the same button that's opened
 Tweaked the SFX's sound volume
 Bigger size for the bush hiding spot
 Tweaked map level design to make it fairer(hunters, traps, bushes, etc.)
 Rotated signs so that the player won't get confused by them
 Modified text for some objectives
 The objectives pop-up will stay on screen longer
 Tweaked the light in houses
 Made the beacons easier to notice
 Replace the "R" button for saving with "F"
 The important events, hunters, items before the first save will be respawned
 Added an icon to loading menu
 New icons on the map for Crossroad and Beacon
 New ground textures
 Faster shine for multiple items
 Hunters will investigate longer


We hope that this patch will improve the experience of the game.
Feel free to give it a try and to give us feedback on the core gameplay!

You can find us on our discord server: https://discord.gg/CYQCqpw
Have a good day!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154300/The_Equinox_Hunt/

notes.title: Steam Game Festival - Summer Edition is ON!
notes.content:
Hello!

We're working on The Equinox Hunt, a stealth game that focuses on a cult of crazy lunatics that treats the player like a prey!


Features

 True stealth. You're not a hunter, you're the VICTIM.
 Multiple enemy factions: Trappers, Prowlers, Marksmen and Cutters, each of them specialized in a unique combat style.
 Each faction leader will subject the player to different situations.
 Use the environment to ease your way out.
 When your character dies, he's gone forever, yet you still have a chance, since the hunt never stops.


We hope that you will enjoy the world that we've created!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154300/The_Equinox_Hunt/
